description: This Dart file defines a centralized configuration class for managing the Supabase client in a Flutter app. It provides methods for initialization, access to the client, status checks, and diagnostic information.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A utility class for managing the Supabase client instance, initialization status, and connection diagnostics within a Flutter application.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Supabase client with provided URL and API key, sets internal state, and prepares diagnostics information.

methods.name: instanceClient
methods.description: Provides access to the initialized Supabase client instance.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Indicates whether the Supabase client has been initialized.

methods.name: effectiveSupabaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used for the last successful initialization.

methods.name: lastConnectionMessage
methods.description: Returns a message about the latest connection status or diagnostic info.

methods.name: debugValidate
methods.description: Performs a validation check on the client's initialization status and logs diagnostic info if not initialized.
